title: daily-scratchpad-gpu-ops-40
content:
Daily scratchpad - GPU ops (personal)
Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Rina K.
Context: quick personal todo + notes while triaging capacity/networking issues and prepping notes for infra sync. Mostly shorthand.

TODAY TOP PRIORITIES
- Finish sizing calc for eu-west-2 Dedicated pool (target: 80% util steady state, headroom for burst to 120% for 2 min). see JIRA-4321.
- Follow up with network on MTU mismatch causing grpc timeouts on nvlink nodes (ticket opened, need packet captures).
- Validate hotfix for kube-device-plugin crash on 2.5.x images (PR 278) -- smoke test on staging tonight.
- Update autoscale policy to include memory percent (not just GPU util) for long-running jobs.

QUICK NOTES / OBSERVATIONS
- Last night's deploy pushed new runtime with batcher change. Observed 15% drop in tail-p99 latency but slight increase in avg token cost (likely due to smaller micro-batch behavior). Need to confirm with per-route traces.
- eu-west-2 Dedicated: 1.2k tokens/sec baseline, spikes to 2.1k during peak — current pool of 16 A100s near threshold. If we keep 80% target, need +4 GPUs (est).
- Packet loss observed between rack-3 and rack-7 (10-30s windows). Suspect MTU mismatch on top-of-rack switch config after firmware update.

COMMANDS / CHECKS TO RUN
- ssh gpu-node-127 (rack-7) -> sudo ethtool -k eth0; check RX drops
- kubectl -n platform logs -l app=kube-device-plugin --since=2h | grep -i crash
- curl -s "https://monitoring.redwood.com/api/metrics?metric=gpu_util&region=eu-west-2&from=-2h" | jq . > /tmp/eu-west2-util.json
- run perftrace: /opt/bin/perf-trace --pid <batcher-pid> --duration 60s -> collect for correlating token-cost bump

ACTION ITEMS (TODO)
- [ ] Add memory threshold rule to autoscale policy (Rina) — due 2026-03-06
- [ ] Get packet capture from rack-7 during spike window (Mateo) — pinged Slack #infra-networking
- [ ] Smoke test kube-device-plugin fix on staging (Elliot) — verify node register stability for 1h
- [ ] Update capacity plan doc with new A100 counts and cost delta for Dedicated eu-west-2 (Rina + Finance)

MEETING NOTES (infra sync 2026-03-04)
- SRE: oncall saw 3 incidents last week related to GRPC timeouts; root cause likely network flaps + MTU.
- Platform: batcher change improved p99 but regressed cost slightly; plan to iterate and add telemetry.
- Product: customer X reported degraded latency in eu-west during heavy seq-8 workloads; flagged for dedicated pool rebalancing.

RISKS / OPEN QUESTIONS
- If we add 4 A100s to eu-west-2, burst capacity still constrained in case of multi-customer spikes. Consider cross-region fallback to eu-central as short-term mitigation.
- Is the nvlink firmware upgrade scheduled next week compatible with our kernel version? Need compatibility matrix.

REFERENCES / LINKS
- Capacity plan (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/GPU+Capacity+Plan
- Ticket: JIRA-4321 (eu-west-2 capacity request)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/278 (kube-device-plugin fix)
- Slack thread: #infra-gpu (https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C03GPUQ1P)

RANDOM NOTES / TODO-LATER
- Try smaller bin-packing algorithm for multi-tenant placement (notes under /notes/packing.md)
- Follow up with procurement on GPU spot pricing trends (Q2 forecast)
- Docs: add a short runbook for MTU mismatch detection and automated remediation steps

END
(keep as personal scratchpad; will extract items for Jira later)
